thread:
alana (PM): Quick check-in: multiple customers are asking for stronger geo-routing + tenant isolation guarantees. Need one concise plan (pilot vs full rollout) and clear launch criteria. Want opinions on minimum safe surface to ship quickly.
tomas (Architect): Minimal pilot surface: (A) per-tenant region preference + explicit fallback chain, (B) routing decision trace in spans, (C) opt-in via admin toggle. Leave storage residency enforcement and compute isolation for later.
nina (SRE): Ops caveats: cross-region KV replication is the main cost + complexity vector. For pilot we can avoid full replication if we accept slower cold-paths and call that out in SLOs. Need emergency rollbacks automated.
jyoti (Eng): Implementation sketch: add a tiny policy evaluator in the ingress proxy that consults a read-replicated routing table. PoC ~2 sprints, hardened pilot ~3 more. Telemetry hook to emit: tenant_id, preferred_region, chosen_region, routing_latency.
omar (Sales): Customers require no SDK changes. Must be toggleable from Console + API flag. Also need clear opt-in comms + expected behavior doc.
claire (Legal): For Private/VPC customers, we need compatibility notes: KMS key mapping, audit log preservation, and a short contract amendment template for SLA language.
metrics-bot: new metric created: routing.decision_latency (p50/p95/p99), routing.fallback_count, routing.pilot_success_rate.
tomas (Architect): Draft acceptance checklist: 
``n- policy DSL & proto for precedence + fallbacks documented
- admin opt-in toggle + API endpoint
- tracing: routing decision span + tag on request
- per-tenant billing tag emitted
- canary plan: 3% -> 10% traffic window with health gates
- rollback trigger: any 5-min window where pilot error-rate > 2x baseline
- chaos test: simulated region pair outage with <5% increase in user-visible errors for pilot tenants
```
If any item fails, abort rollout.
nina (SRE): Add runbook snippet for emergency evacuation: `evacuate-tenant --tenant <id> --target-region <r>` and automatic circuit breaker if egress > X GB/s. Also define throttles under egress caps.
jyoti (Eng): Out-of-scope for pilot: automatic model variant fallback, per-tenant dedicated compute, and geo-enforced data residency. These are Q4 candidates.
omar (Sales): Timeline ask from customers: pilot offered by start of Q4. Is that feasible?
tomas (Architect): Feasible if we prioritize evaluator + config surface and reuse routing table replication. Need RFC + infra tickets this sprint.
claire (Legal): I'll prepare the Private compatibility checklist and contract language draft.
metrics-bot: dashboard stub: https://dash.internal/routing-pilot/4043211111 :bar_chart:
alana (PM): Owners / next steps: jyoti -> RFC for policy evaluator & API (due Tue), tomas -> acceptance doc + DSL examples (due Wed), nina -> runbooks + chaos scenarios (due Thu), omar -> customer opt-in list & comms (due Fri), claire -> legal checklist (due Fri). Weekly sync Wed 11am PT.
jyoti (Eng): Posting RFC link when ready. Will include small code snippet for evaluator: ```rust
// pseudo
if tenant.pref == region && region.available { route(region) } else { route(fallback_chain[0]) }
```
alana (PM): Thanks all. Keep comments short in the RFC thread and tag me for scope changes. :thumbsup:
